name: SoCon Cross Country Championships
where: Mill Spring, NC · Tryon International Equestrian Center
headline: SoCon Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Furman swept the SoCon titles. The Paladins men scored 15 points to UNCG's 92, going 1-2-3-4-5 with Christopher Knight winning the 8K in 23:57.0. The Furman women scored 19 to Mercer's 79, led by Tessa Walter's 16:24.8 win in the 5K.
